paragraphs: Mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 8, halakhah 6, reporting in the name of R' Nachum, son of R' Simai. Beitzah, chapter 5, halakhah 4, reads R' Yochanan of Katzein.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Kartzein/ Katzein preserve the resh difference in supplied דקרציין/דקציין, without modern location binding. Earlier audit דקרציון and inherited provisional heading remain unadjudicated. ר״י is contextually Yochanan in the variant, with title R'; no full title is established by the heading.

8h 6/5h 4 are explicit; Beitzah naturally continues Jerusalem Talmud, without a fresh check. The headed Yochanan is the natural implicit reporter. Both Nachum and his father Simai retain their separate abbreviated titles as R'.
